The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] had a '''Command Sector''' located in the northern hemisphere. It was located at the northern pole of the [[battle station]], above the [[Meridian trench/Legends|meridian trench]].<ref name="EGVV" />
